# Feather Fall (`spells:feather-fall`)
**Level 1 [Transmutation](../magic-schools/transmutation.md)** | **Casting Time:** Reaction, which you take when you or a creature you can see within 60 feet of you falls | **Range:** 60 feet
**Components:** V, M (a small feather or piece of down) | **Duration:** 1 minute | **Classes:** [Bard](../classes/bard.md), [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)

Choose up to five falling creatures within range. A falling creature's rate of descent slows to 60 feet per round until the spell ends. If a creature lands before the spell ends, the creature takes no damage from the fall, and the spell ends for that creature.
